items.subject: EMAIL INTEREST ONLY: Housing Officer needed urgently - West London - up to £31.54/hr
items.summary: Urgent short-term Housing Officer cover in West London paying up to £31.54 per hour umbrella, initially for one month with possible extension, managing up to 600 properties. Applicants must drive and have access to a vehicle, and hold or be willing to complete CIH Level 3.
items.action: Decide whether the short-term role interests you and whether the driver and vehicle requirement works. If yes, reply with your up-to-date CV and confirm your CIH Level 3 position.
items.decisionNeeded: Whether to express interest in the one-month West London Housing Officer contract.
